FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Harmony Trust Bank specializes in providing a wide range of financial services to individuals and small businesses, focusing on community banking. Our core operations include offering checking and savings accounts, personal and business loans, mortgage lending, and financial advising. We prioritize regulatory compliance and customer service excellence, ensuring that our financial products meet the needs of our community while adhering to all necessary regulations. Additionally, we maintain a secure banking environment, including secure vaults for sensitive assets, and have implemented robust security measures to protect customer data. Our commitment to transparency and ethical practices allows us to build trust and foster relationships within the community.

Our institution conducts its operations without maintaining a formal compliance program, relying instead on informal practices to ensure adherence to regulations.
